name: Rosé Pine
author: CatVinci-Studio
description: Soft and natural: Rosé Pine Dawn's warm paper by day and Rosé Pine's deep night after dark, iris accents, pine links and rose quotes. On the Rosé Pine palette.

zh.description: 柔和自然：白天是 Rosé Pine Dawn 的暖色纸面，夜里换成 Rosé Pine 的深色，鸢尾紫点缀、松绿链接、玫瑰色引用。基于 Rosé Pine 配色。
